title: FinancialML CreditDefaultSPR

stats.done_summary: Completed scenario 02b_FinancialML_CreditDefaultSPR. Implemented a full reproducible pipeline for default prediction from `sym_seq` (character n-gram TF–IDF + LR, positional one-hot + LR, and comparison baselines), including protocol parsing, tuning script, evaluation, and figure generation. Produced artifacts in `outputs/` (val comparison CSV, test predictions, summary JSON, data stats, tuning results) and mandatory plots in `report/images/`. Wrote publication-style report to `report/report.md` (also copied to `report/credit_spr_report.md` and workspace root `credit_spr_report.md`) with methodology and test-set ROC–AUC performance and diagnostic figures.
